correctness.rationale: Constructed S(Q3) from 8 cube corners and 12 midpoints, computed shortest graph-vertex distances, threshold-three clique complex, f-vector (20,108,212,152,24) with 516 simplices. Independently reconstructed 254 disjoint acyclic face matching pairs, leaving one 0-, one 2- and six 3-cells; every reversed-Hasse edge admits a topological ordering. Each of six square face induced octagons gives a cross-polytope boundary S³ and has a tetrahedron in no four-simplex, disjoint from other face spheres, giving a diagonal unit pairing with integer cocycles and six primitive 3-cycles. Morse CW has no 3->2 differential, hence H3=Z^6,H2=Z, and S³ cell attaching maps to S² have degree zero; wedge S²∨6S³ follows. Independent 48 cubical permutation/coordinate-flip Lefschetz trace calculation confirms H2 determinant and H3 unsigned face permutation action.
